definitions.gloss: music stand; a stand for holding sheet music
definitions.explanation: A freestanding, usually adjustable frame or rack designed to hold sheet music at a comfortable reading height for a musician during practice or performance.

examples.japanese: {譜面台|ふめんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I placed the sheet music on the music stand.

examples.japanese: {譜面台|ふめんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}して→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please adjust the height of the music stand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧{式|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{譜面台|ふめんだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{持|も}ち{運|はこ}び→持ち運び：03164_mochihakobi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧になった。
examples.english: I bought a folding music stand, which made it easier to carry.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{譜面|ふめん}→譜面：11103_fumen⟧ (sheet music, musical score) and {台|だい} (stand, platform). A standard term used in music contexts. While {譜面台|ふめんだい} is the most common Japanese term, the English loanword is not typically used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {譜面台|ふめんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧: to put sheet music on the stand
- {譜面台|ふめんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: the height of the music stand
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧{譜面台|ふめんだい}: folding music stand

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{譜面|ふめん}→譜面：11103_fumen⟧: sheet music, musical score
- ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧: sheet music — more formal term
- ⟦{指揮台|しきだい}→指揮台：26423_shikidai⟧: conductor's podium
